$comment: Package H: statements about the strip in docs/G20-DESIGN-SPEC.md (sections 0, 2, 3, 4.1, 5, 8), docs/BOTTOM-ROW-PACKAGE.md, the OVERLAY, CAR3 and POLISH reports, the comments in design/gen_6wb.py / shared/hud.js, design/g20-spec/measured.json and the brief's own photo table, checked against the photos. 'verdict': confirmed / refuted / partly / conflict / unsupported / superseded. 'status': verified (looked at or measured on a photo, or read from the source) or hypothesis. 'on': which rects: R = package R's bake/work/strip/rect (60-64 at the time), B = package B's bake/work/overlay/rect (08, 09, 10, 14, 17, 39), Hq = H's provisional SIFT rects (63-67, +-2-5 px at the strip's ends; geometry from them is provisional), orig = the original photo by eye.

claims.source: G20-DESIGN-SPEC 5.1; gen_6wb.py comment ('The stock field has no fill of its own')
claims.claim: no fill under the message
claims.on: B 08 (= 62), Hq 66, B 17; contrast-stretched max(RGB) 0-70 levels (tools/strip/H/fill_check.py)
claims.evidence: a gradient band hangs under the rail, shaped by it and ending at its tips: max(RGB) median 91 / 102 / 74 (08 / 66 / 17) in [800,612,1120,626] against 25-30 just above the rail and 18-35 in the same box with no message (63, 67, 61, 64). Not camera bloom: nothing comparable above the rail. The spec's test rested on 42/43, two photos of OUR theme. The simulation (POLISH-C, c.js ccFill) had drawn a fill.
claims.to_correct: spec 5.1, 6 item 3; gen_6wb.py comment above NAV_BAR; BOTTOM-ROW-PACKAGE 3

claims.claim: the marker right of the rail is a severity marker that appears with the message
claims.evidence: 63: 'i' marker, no message; 67: warning triangle, no message; 64, 61: neither. The 'i' sits at [1256.2,591.8,1270.8,627.0] on R 63 and [1256.0,591.8,1270.5,627.2] on R 62: the same slot with and without a panel.

43's triangle is cut by our 0.7.7 box window (I_WIN) - the measured box is the window. The whole triangle is ~42 x 36: [1241.5,590.3,1283.5,626.4] (Hq 66/67), centred x ~1263 like the 'i'. 17's is cut at the top by the media list.

claims.claim: the street label shows whenever the check-control line is free
claims.evidence: 63: no message and no street (the centre shows the car picture; a faint odometer ghost sits in the line). 65: standby, odometer in its place. It holds for 61, 64, 67, 68.

claims.claim: the mode label is in the row only with a theme connected or the centre occupied
claims.evidence: 63 and 67 have the centre occupied (car picture) and keep the label in the tacho; 65 (standby, no theme) has it in the row at x ~1226 (Hq, chained). Rule seen: theme connected (10 = 60, 14, 17) or standby (65).

claims.claim: P with the engine off is BMW's standby screen, which draws no sign
claims.evidence: 62 / 63: P, engine off (tacho reads OFF, the ready-to-drive message), and BMW draws the normal row: sign, belts, panel, marker. Standby (65) is a separate state: odometer centre, mode label in the row, no sign, no belts, no rpm label.
claims.to_correct: BOTTOM-ROW-PACKAGE 3 (the sign bullet), hud.js comment and mode-3 condition, the brief's definition of standby

claims.claim: 17 is stock
claims.evidence: BMW's black box at [1420,320,1611,440] over the media list; mode label (x 1223.2) and gear P [1395.5,667.2,1420.2,700.5] in the row: BMW's drawing with a theme connected. 17 and 66 are not the same state: they are the with-theme / without-theme pair of one message.

claims.claim: the 2026-11-16 set is nine new photos
claims.evidence: 60 = 10, 61 = 09, 62 = 08, 68 = 39 (identity transform, NCC >= 0.998, same capture second). New exposures: 63, 64, 65, 66, 67 (63 shares 62's framing). Any 'second photo' cross-check between those pairs is one observation twice.
claims.to_correct: brief 2.1 / 4.2; every zone package's 'falsify on a second photo'

claims.source: brief 2.2; CAR3-K table ('package J decides whether this is stock')
claims.claim: 39 / 40 status disputed
claims.evidence: see provenance.json 39 / 40: no row mode label or gear (BMW draws the gear over any theme), big D + label in the tacho (0.7.7 drew neither), no black box between 38 and 41 which both have it, BMW's crossed MSA sign visible. 40 is 10 s later, same state.
claims.to_correct: nothing in the spec (it already says stock); the earlier audit that called them ours

claims.evidence: B rects: x 537.7-539.1, y 621.6-621.8 (14: 623.8). R rects: x 537.2-538.0, y 621.9-622.9, r_outer 41.6-42.0 at a half-of-p99 redness threshold. Every source puts r_outer > 40.
claims.to_correct: ZL owns the number; SIGN_WIN (constants rank 1)

claims.claim: r 40 loses only the outermost 1.5 px of BMW's red ring, invisible
claims.verdict: refuted in effect (hypothesis for the asymmetry)
claims.evidence: the loss is 1.6-1.8 px nominal, and with the centre's +-1 px it is uneven: ~0.8 px at one side, ~2.6 px at the other of an ~8.3 px ring. Package O measures it on 68.png.
half-max ink of the rail ends at x 710.5 / 1211.2, y <= 617.5 (R 62); 711.5 / 1210.8 (B 08); 710.8 (B 17). POLISH-D also says <= 1211. Which 'end' of a tapering tip is meant must be stated.

claims.claim: symbol right-aligned at x 752.9
gear letter P [1395.1,666.9,1419.9,700.1]; mode label left x 1223
row alignment (range / clock / temperature anchors) not settled
claims.evidence: the new set adds only 3-digit ranges, hours starting with 1 and +d.d temperatures. The OWN boxes' anchors stay guesses (constants rank 10).

claims.claim: the belt and airbag lamps are BMW's, drawn over any theme
claims.evidence: only bottom.belt_driver is 'over' (strong); belt_rear and airbag are 'unknown'. Settled only by package D's matte photo.

claims.claim: 39 is the master, cross-checked on 09, 08, 17, 34, 41
claims.evidence: 41's model is fitted 'via 39' and 34/42/43 'via 41': the hi-res chain is one registration. 68 / 61 / 62 add no exposures. Independent stock exposures in the spec: 39, 09, 08, 17 (17 with a theme).

claims.claim: 08 is a night photo
claims.evidence: taken at dusk (local late afternoon in November); the panel is in its day/dusk look, not the night one. Matters for colour, not geometry.

claims.claim: the road bar is wider than BMW's own 331 px field
claims.evidence: 331 px is one street's ink width (09); the widest seen is 509 px (34) and the spec's field is ~520 px.

claims.claim: the belts and airbag end at x 679, the bar from 690 never covers them
ccSym is x 709-790
two-line message = name on line 1, description on line 2
claims.evidence: the only stock two-line message (08 = 62) is one sentence broken after a colon; the photo cannot say which struct field each line came from

claims.claim: BMW's drive-mode label is fully black under the baked collar (opaque x 1232-1488 from y 650)
claims.evidence: the label starts at x 1223.2 (17): x 1223-1232 is outside the quoted opaque span. In all6WB NAV_BAR (to 1250) covers it while own:nav; O checks the other states.

claims.claim: the clock is centred (x ~397), the range left-aligned after the pump, the temperature right-aligned
with a theme BMW moves the mode label and gear into the row and the black box covers the old gear spot
claims.evidence: the label and gear move every time; the box is absent in 34 (CAR3-K): the label, not the box, is the reliable sign of a connected theme

claims.claim: BMW's sign measured on 34, 37, 41, 42, 43
claims.evidence: all OURS (BMW's sign through our window, an 'under' element), one registration chain (from our own drawing); valid for the sign, independent of B's stock rects, and the source of the 537.3

claims.claim: the cover keeps 3 px clear of the frame, text and 'i' (from 08)
claims.evidence: 08 holds only the 'i' and two lines; the door / heated-wheel symbols, the triangle marker, the mode label and the under-rail fill (C1) were never in its keep-out

claims.claim: the check-control outline ends at x <= 1211 for y >= 659
standby is a different arrangement; the marker is independent of the panel; the message takes the road label's place; the belt group varies (1 in 64); the sign sits in one seat
a faint odometer ghost at the bottom centre
claims.status: verified (presence), hypothesis (a fade between standby and the normal row: 63 is 1 s after 62)

claims.claim: an auto start/stop icon
claims.evidence: BMW's CROSSED 'A START STOP' (MSA off) in the place of the rpm label, x ~1405-1506 (CAR3-J), as in 39 (the same frame)

claims.claim: open items
claims.evidence: the new set settles none of section 8's rows (no video, no end-of-limit, no no-passing, no 3-digit limit, no plate, no non-white message, no long street, no 4-digit range / 1-digit hour / negative temperature). It does settle: the marker without a message (C2), standby (C5, C6), the fill (C1).
